notes.title: Desaturation Prologue 1.0.9 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Heyo Humans, Splatians & Slimes[/h1]

A [b]color-pocalypse[/b] is happening and it's your turn to fix the mess that Lord Ashen did. 
[b]We've heard your feedback[/b] and implemented things you proposed to make the game not that annoyingly difficult. Many things are changed between 1.0.0 and 1.0.9, but for the prologue, whatever matters the most is what we did to the Slimes. 

[h3][b]S.L.I.M.E.[/b] won't [b]kill you[/b] on the slightest touch if you share a color[/h3]
If you don't share color with a slime, keep distance, wait for it to jump or dash and then stomp it down. 
If even one of your colors matches the Slime color, even if that slime dashes in front of you, your life is saved. This makes S.P.A.R.K. Forest much easier map to explore.  

[h3]Check out the full game, [b]PRICE DROP[/b][/h3]
We re also happy to announce that the [b]price took some HP of damage[/b] and dropped as a result! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/670510/ColorBlend_FX_Desaturation

notes.title: Desaturation Prologue 1.0.0 Patch Notes + Release Date!
notes.content:
[h1]Heyo Humans, Splatians & Slimes[/h1]

A [b]color-pocalypse[/b] is undoubtedly incoming. The secret project [b]DESATURATION[/b] that caused the extinction of the humanity is about to enter another phase and threaten the current Earth residents, [b]the Splatians[/b]. We are extremely thankful for your support and love for Desaturation. We are thrilled to share some news - [b]one of which is the release date itself[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888513/32a750227497a05074c48ad8515d247a361b544e.png[/img]
Yes, that's it, the game will release in just 3 weeks, on [b]19 April 2024[/b]. We are very sorry for making you wait that much, but we also wanted to make the game feel as [b]completed and polished[/b] as possible and to convert this free prologue to serve its purpose as the [b]game demo[/b].

[h1]Here is what's new in 1.0.0-pr5[/h1]
[h3]in comparison to the old 1.0.0-whatever-it-was[/h3]
Yeah, we are in this beautiful 1.0 era when lots of stuff changes but version number stays the same.

This prologue build is on par with the first release candidate of the game, but some things will change before the release.
[list]
[*] Total graphics overhaul such as: 
[*] New post processing, 
[*] Lots of vegetation
[*] More detailed geometry by using tessellation
[*] Levels like Library and the Forest will feel refreshed for you.
[*] More props, more barrels, 
[*] More physics details. e.g. Tables break.
[*] FSR 2.0 upscaler and hardware tessellation
[*] Some small physics tweaks and many bugfixes.
[*] [b]Steam Input.[/b] Please make sure you update your controller config!
[/list]
And with all these improvements, here are some possibly-sad news. I love all you achievement hunters who hunted on the old Prologue and checked every nook and cranny. [b]When you buy the full game, your progress will carry[/b], but the full game features much more different achievements. [b]And achievements will not carry[/b] from the Prologue to the full game. So, I went off and removed Photons & Matter completely from the Prologue - so no Spring Shoes, coins, vents and similar. And because I prefer to be honest, another reason for this change is to make the prologue shorter with very strong call to action in its ending - and a short teaser trailer too. And your old saves will not work with the new version. Just start over, experience the updated chapter, and if you loved it.

[h3]Wishlist ColorBlend FX: Desaturation[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/670510/ColorBlend_FX_Desaturation

[h3]Important for Steam Deck:[/h3]
Because the game now defaults to use Steam Input, please check and reset your controller configuration to the new official one. If you want to keep constant 58-60 fps, enable manual GPU clocking and set it above 1.2GHz. The FSR 2.0 implementation in its "As Intended" quality level may actually [b]be slower[/b] than [i]Marketing Mode[/i] - but Balanced also works well. Alternatively, you can lower the resolution and enable FSR 1.0 for both increased frame rate and battery savings.

[h3]Help us grow![/h3]
Let us defeat Lord Ashen together! If you loved the game feel free to make videos and let's plays. If you are a blogger, feel free to review. And...

[h3]Follow us on Social Media:[/h3]
[url=https://instagram.com/petersvp] Follow on Instagram[/url] | [url=https://discord.gg/MfrU9tJDnZ]Join our Discord[/url]

notes.title: ColorBlend FX: Desaturation Prologue 1.0.0b
notes.content:
[h3]Hey guys, friends, humans, Splatians and Slimes[/h3]
Some time had passed but lots of things were changed with the development of [b]ColorBlend FX: Desaturation.[/b] Yes, the focus is now on the word [b]Desaturation[/b] and the game is almost ready!

[h3]About the Release Date?[/h3]
Yes, I've missed the originally intended March 14th and those of you who were waiting for the release, I'm very sorry, but these things tend to happen in this industry. I don't want to give any promise for a release date until I am sure it will happen, but it will be soon. I mean, [b]within next 2 months for sure.[/b] 

To keep in touch, [b][url=https://discord.gg/MfrU9tJDnZ]please join our Discord[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://instagram.com/petersvp]follow me on Instagram[/url][/b]

What happens now is, however, a [b]huge Prologue update[/b] with [b]LOTS of stuff changed[/b]. This update is in feature parity with the latest 1.0 beta (Though the Atrium is still not decorated)

[h3]Let's see what's the changelog[/h3]
And I will be honest. 0.3 was so long time ago that I can barely track what was changed, and I should avoid game spoilers too.... [b]So, let's jump in:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed the Speedrun Mode and the Steam Achievement for it. The final game will feature something else instead this mode. It was made specially for the Prologue, and maintaining it wasn't nessesary. [i](wait, did I just started with a feature removal? ohhh my bad skills...)[/i]
[*] More vegetation, more decoration, more props! Makes the game much more alive.
[*] Altered the rendering part and post-processing. The game looks a little bit different.
[*] Overall polished the levels.
[*] All the physics changes are integrated. Though, sprinting still makes you slippery as it's intended - you are a heavy fat potato gnome after all :)
[*] Totally new user interface, again!
[*] Map has been redesigned for a 38429th time. Don't forget to craft it from the redesigned briefcase.
[*] Slime Essence and coins now occupy a slot into the briefcase unlike before.
[*] UI navigation was polished, hopefully it don't have any more bugs left.
[*] Graphics Settings: Added back the Quality level, with 3 presets.
[*] Added some pizzas that were intended to be an April fools day joke but I never managed to release that as a prologue update. You are getting it as an Mid-June Fools instead :D 
[*] Steam Deck: Fixed some bugs, however, the game still defaults to the built-in controls and not the external ones. I am planning to add Steam Input API support, but releasing the full game is of more priority now. Quality may be degraded a bit on the Deck but that's for the battery and you can always switch to the high quality mode. Enable VRR for better battery savings.
[/list]

[h3]AND finally the IMPORTANT NEWS:[/h3]
The game is 100% ready as of gameplay. However, I need help - we have very limited budget, so this is a call to my fans to help with localizing the game in some languages.

[h3]ALSO THERE IS A CLOSED BETA available[/h3]
To get more information on how to join our closed beta, [url=https://discord.gg/MfrU9tJDnZ]Join our Discord[/url] and ask [b]PeterSvP[/b] directly.

[h3]Help us grow![/h3]
If you like the game and plan to buy it, wishlist the base game, and if not, at least tell your friends and stream/show it to others! Let us defeat Lord Ashen together!

Not just that, but this new demo is based on what we are doing right now and contains many improvements and new content in comparison with this free Prologue!

And if you really [b]loved [/b]it to the point of wanting the full game, don't forget to [b]wishlist & spread the word[/b]! And [url=https://instagran,com/petersvp]follow me on Instagram[/url] for even more updates + [url=https://discord.gg/MfrU9tJDnZ]join our Discord[/url] for feedback!

notes.title: ColorBlend FX: Desaturation Prologue 0.1.9b PATCH NOTES,
notes.content:
Okay, I know and I've heard you all, and I'm very sorry for leaving these stupid bugs... 
After all as a almost solo dev sometimes some stuff just gets unnoticed!

Here's what is new in 0.1.9b:

[list]
[*] [b]Fixed all pressure plates[/b]. This means that Photons and matter is now working
[*] [b]Fixed all Slime spawners[/b]. Slimes will now properly leave pipes
[*] All fixes from main branch of the game and all improvements are in the prologue now
[*] Coins now collect automatically if they somehow leave the map
[*] And this time I actually did an extensive testing to ensure the quality of this build!
[/list]

notes.title: THE MOST DESATURATED SPEEDRUN STARTS NOW!
notes.content:
Hello [b]Splatians[/b], [b]Slimes[/b] and [b]Ashen Minions[/b]! 

After some bug fixes, new levels behind the scenes and potential translations collaboration, we are proud to announce the most colorless speedrun contest:

[h2]Desaturation Prologue any% Speedrun![/h2]

[b]HERE'S WHAT TO DO:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Download the free [b]ColorBlend FX: Desaturation Prologue[/b] if you didn't do that already,
[*]Be sure you are on latest patch or newer - [b]0.1.7f[/b]
[*]Play it, get used to it, [b]learn [/b]and master it. The demo is like 50 minutes to 1:30h long!
[*]Start [b]a new game[/b], name your character just [i]q[/i]. [u]This will enable the timer[/u]!
[*][b]Record your full playthrough[/b]! In Speedrun mode, story events will be skpped or be short!
[*]Using glitches is allowed, this is true any%!
[*][b]Post your video to YouTube[/b]! (or any video sharing site, as long as video is permanent)
[*][b]Join our[/b] [url=https://discord.com/invite/w5DvMee]official Discord Server[/url]
[*]Post your video in the Speedruns channel. Only this way we will consider you as participant for the prizes!
[/olist]

[b]PRIZES:[/b]
At around First of October, following prizes will be awarded:
[olist]
[*][b]The current Speedrun World Record holder[/b] will receive three games on Steam of his choice from Peter's Humble Bundle collection, [b]or[/b] one game up to $30.
[*][b]The YouTuber[/b] with biggest audience / view count will also receive a game on Steam of his choice from Peter's Humble Bundle collection.
[*]Depending of participation, other participants and YouTubers may also receive free game from Peter's Humble Bundle collection.
[*]Also, everyone who won something will be gifted a steam beta key for the full upcoming game, so you can try the newest levels in the making [i]but also experience all sorts of funny glitches[/i]!
[/olist]

The [b]more entries[/b] we get, the [b]bigger the rewards[/b] will be, it only depends on you all, so get in and [b]invite your friends[/b] to try the game!

[b]Follow us, and share us, on social media - [url=https://twitter.com/petersvp]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/petersvp/]Instagram[/url] - to keep track of the game development and help us grow! Also [url=https://discord.com/invite/w5DvMee]join our Discord​[/url].[/b]

notes.title: Desaturation Prologue 0.1.7f Patch Notes
notes.content:
0. Achievements should not bug out anymore.
1. All progression achievements will now unlock when you resume game if you completed them
2. Yes, I know, you hated the Spark Forest Electric pool.... so a checkpoint was added after it.
3. And I got you too, the boss is now much more challenging and have more HP! 
4. The secret speed-run mode was broken, this is now fixed and the timer also pauses during loadings!
5. Wish this in mind, SPEED RUN CONTEST is now a thing, join our Discord and stay tuned
